zh.title: 时区诊断与键盘操作改进
zh.summary: 完善时区加载失败的诊断分类，并改善键盘操作体验。

items.text: 完善主面板与收藏对比的时区加载诊断，区分网络、超时和响应读取失败，便于反馈与排查问题。
改善桌面标题返回按钮与云层功能菜单的键盘可访问性，并保留横向表格的键盘滚动入口。

en.title: Time zone diagnostics and keyboard controls
en.summary: Clearer diagnostics for time zone loading failures and improved keyboard controls.

items.text: Improved time zone loading diagnostics in the main panel and favorite comparisons, distinguishing network, timeout and response-reading failures to help report and investigate issues.
Improved keyboard accessibility of the desktop title back button and cloud function menu while retaining keyboard scrolling for horizontal tables.
